content_sections.heading: Nandyal Anganwadi Vacancy Details (AWC-Wise)
content_sections.text: The 70 vacancies are distributed across 6 ICDS Projects in Nandyal District, covering specific Anganwadi Centres (AWCs) as listed in the notification. There are 3 Anganwadi Worker vacancies and 67 Anganwadi Helper vacancies. Note: Row 67 of the Anganwadi Helper list is not fully legible in the source document; the Mandal and AWC name are not specified.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Worker Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must ordinarily have passed at least 10th class (SSC). As on 01.07.2026, the candidate must be 21 years of age and below 35 years. The candidate must ordinarily be married and must be a local resident. In ICDS-notified habitation areas, if candidates aged 21 years and above are not available, those aged 18 years and above will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Anganwadi Helper Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must ordinarily have passed 10th class; if no candidate with 10th class pass is available, a candidate with a lower educational qualification who can read and write may be considered. As on 01.07.2026, the candidate must be 21 years of age and below 35 years. The candidate must ordinarily be married and must be a local resident. In ICDS-notified habitation areas, if candidates aged 21 years and above are not available, those aged 18 years and above will be considered. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of birth/age proof certificate Caste proof certificate Educational qualification proof – SSC marks list and Transfer Certificate (TC); if below SSC, the marks list and TC of the class studied Residence proof certificate For widows: husband’s death proof certificate, and if there are children below 18 years, their age proof certificate For persons with disabilities: PHC (Primary Health Centre) certificate For widows: Aadhaar card and ration card All the above supporting documents must be submitted as self-attested photocopies along with the application.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare the application along with self-attested photocopies of all required supporting documents listed above. Submit the application in person at the CDPO (Child Development Project Officer) office concerned with the AWC/mandal you are applying for. Applications will be accepted from 05.09.2026, 10:30 A.M., to 18.09.2026, 5:00 P.M., on all working days at the concerned offices.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from eligible women candidates meeting the age, qualification, and local residence criteria specified for each post. The power to make any changes to this notification, change the number of vacancies, or cancel it at any time rests with the District Collector. Candidates should apply to the CDPO office relevant to the specific AWC/mandal for which they are eligible.

faq.question: Q1. What is Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification by the District Women & Child Welfare and Empowerment Officer, Nandyal District, to fill 70 Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts across 6 ICDS Projects in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 70 vacancies in total - 3 Anganwadi Worker posts and 67 Anganwadi Helper posts, spread across specific Anganwadi Centres in Atmakur, Nandyal, Dhone, Allagadda, Banaganapalli, and Nandikotkur Projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted at the concerned CDPO office by 18.09.2026, 5:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Anganwadi Worker, the candidate must have passed at least 10th class. For Anganwadi Helper, 10th class pass is the ordinary requirement, but a candidate with a lower qualification who can read and write may be considered if no 10th-pass candidate is available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and below 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026, for both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. In ICDS-notified habitation areas, candidates aged 18 and above may be considered if no candidates aged 21+ are available.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are not submitted online. Candidates must submit the application along with self-attested copies of supporting documents in person at the concerned CDPO office, between 05.09.2026 and 18.09.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Are only local residents eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Both Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts require candidates to be ordinarily married and local residents of the respective area.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for Nandyal Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Required documents include date of birth/age proof, caste certificate, educational qualification proof (marks list and TC), residence proof, and, where applicable, widow/disability-related certificates as listed in the Documents Required section above.
